title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows: shared meeting timer from the room console
summary: The briefing accurately reports the planned room-console timer, the January CY2027 target and the roadmap's Teams Rooms Pro licence condition. The published Pro price is supported, and independent searches did not identify timer-specific administration, rollout or audit documentation.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; What's changing; Why it matters
claims.claim: The timer's default state and what happens on arrival are not stated.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Windows meeting countdown timer admin switch default app version rollout audit logs PowerShell XML Pro license; read roadmap, mtr-home-refresh, release notes, XML configuration and available device settings. No timer default found.

claims.where: What's changing; front matter: confidence; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Microsoft Learn does not describe this room-console timer at the time of writing in November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Windows meeting countdown timer; Teams Rooms meeting timer licensing default roles audit recording data; read home-screen controls, searched release notes for timer/countdown. Found Facilitator agenda timers, not this console-managed timer.

claims.where: controls[0] (ui and api null); summary; Risk assessment; Governance controls
claims.claim: No timer-specific admin switch, policy parameter or API is documented in November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms timer PowerShell countdown; Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy timer; Teams Rooms countdown timer Graph API. Read home-screen controls, Pro portal settings; searched device-settings-available, XML configuration and Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy for timer/countdown: no matches.

claims.claim: The roadmap does not specify which meeting roles may start the timer.
claims.quote: Start, pause, resume, or cancel a timer from the room’s touch console, with the countdown visible on the front-of-room display and in participants’ meeting views. Available with a Teams Rooms Pro license.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not published timer-specific rollout mechanics.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Windows meeting countdown timer app version rollout; read roadmap and searched Teams Rooms release notes for timer/countdown. General app/web update mechanisms exist, but no rollout mechanism for this timer was found.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not published a required app version for this timer.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Windows meeting countdown timer app version rollout; read New Teams Rooms feature not available search excerpt and searched rooms-release-note for timer/countdown. No version introducing this timer found.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not published the release channel for this timer.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Windows meeting countdown timer app version rollout; read roadmap, home-screen release-ring guidance and searched release notes. General release rings are documented, but none is specified for this timer.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not published the roles needed to configure this timer.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms meeting timer licensing default roles audit recording data; read Pro portal settings and device settings. General Rooms Management permissions exist, but no timer configuration or associated role requirement was found.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Why it matters; rationale: risk
claims.claim: No source describes this timer reading new organisational data or storing data beyond its meeting.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms meeting timer licensing default roles audit recording data; read roadmap, home-screen controls and release-note search results. No data-access or storage description for this console timer found; Facilitator is a different feature.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated whether timer actions appear in meeting records or audit logs.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms meeting timer licensing default roles audit recording data; read returned recording/transcription and consent-log excerpts, roadmap and Pro settings-job history. None states that timer actions are recorded or audited.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The roadmap does not describe automatic or AI-driven timer actions.
claims.quote: Start, pause, resume, or cancel a timer from the room’s touch console, with the countdown visible on the front-of-room display and in participants’ meeting views.

claims.claim: No timer-specific security or identity change is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms meeting timer licensing default roles audit recording data; read roadmap, home-screen controls, licences and Pro portal settings. No timer-specific identity or security change found.

claims.claim: Microsoft documents room-level Teams Rooms on Windows settings in the Pro Management portal.
claims.quote: On Teams Rooms on Windows devices: open the Pro Management Portal > Rooms > select your room > Settings > Meetings > toggle Allow ad hoc room reservation to control this functionality.

claims.claim: The documented room-level settings are not documented as governing this timer.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Windows meeting countdown timer admin switch; read mtr-home-refresh and pro-portal-settings, searched device-settings-available and XML configuration for timer/countdown. No documented timer setting or linkage to other room controls found.

claims.claim: The Teams Rooms licences page does not list a price for the Pro licence discussed in the licensing notes.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms meeting timer licensing; read the complete rooms-licensing page. It describes Basic at no additional cost and Pro purchasing channels, but gives no Pro price. The separate cited Compare Rooms plans page supplies the Pro price.
